name: ROKAE CMR-L Large-Payload Mobile Manipulator
summary: The heavy member of ROKAE's CMR mobile manipulator range: a 1.6 m long four-directional laser-SLAM chassis with a 200 Ah battery carrying a ROKAE CR cobot of 35 or 45 kg payload, with a 1 x 1 m load area on the platform.

germany.statusNote: ROKAE (Beijing) takes enquiries through sales@rokae.com and a web form; its readable pages name no German or EU distributor for the CMR series.

specs.label: Arm payload
specs.conditions: 35 kg or 45 kg ROKAE CR cobot; working range 2246 mm or 1947 mm

specs.label: Arm
specs.value: ROKAE CR series 35 kg or 45 kg AC-powered cobot
specs.quote: Supports CR Series 35 kg and 45 kg AC-powered large-payload Cobots

specs.label: Chassis weight
specs.conditions: as labelled on the maker's table

specs.label: Load area on platform
specs.quote: Supports material placement up to 1,000 x 1,000 mm on the platform

specs.label: Navigation and travel
specs.value: Laser SLAM; forward, backward and traverse

notes: Arm payload 35 or 45 kg depending on the CR cobot fitted; gripper per application.
Platform payload in kg not stated for this series, only the 1 x 1 m load area.
Sister series CMR-S (light) and CMR-CR (battery swapping) are separate records.
